prompts: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape Study Buddy infographic for Analysis Reporting Lesson 2.2. Title exactly 'From data to a clear report'. Adult learning design, warm white, navy typography, muted teal and restrained amber, generous spacing and highly readable English. Show six connected conceptual stages with document and analysis icons: 'Purpose and reader', 'Data and method', 'Findings', 'Interpretation', 'Conclusion', 'Action and limits'. Under the chain put the sentence 'Every conclusion must follow from the evidence.' Small side note 'A story explains the data. It does not replace the data.' Bottom band 'Use clear headings, purposeful visuals and traceable sources.' Make the interpretation step distinct from findings, and the action step conditional on evidence. No numerical data, real brand logos, fake software screenshots, fabricated citations or completion checkmarks. Original conceptual study aid, not an official solution.

Use case: scientific-educational. Create a landscape Study Buddy Task 2.2 infographic with title exactly 'Nice Ride report workflow'. Adult study design, warm white, navy, muted teal and restrained amber; clean icon-led seven-step path, readable English. Seven clearly numbered cards: '1 Read the brief', '2 Enter six brand counts', '3 Check the leading brand', '4 Create a column chart', '5 Structure the Word report', '6 Comment after the chart', '7 Reopen and check'. Use a conceptual vertical-column chart icon at step4, without numeric scales or data claims. Add a required-output panel with exactly 'MS Word report', 'Heading styles', 'Column plot', 'Short comment after the plot'. Add note exactly 'Most popular means highest sales count in the supplied data.' Footer exactly 'Do not infer causes, profit, dates or individual shop results.' No horizontal bar chart substitution, fabricated statistics, car logos, fake Word interface, chart claimed as completed work, official marking scheme or real dealership branding.
edit_prompt: Edit only the small explanatory text beneath step 4 in this Task 2.2 infographic. Replace the whole sentence 'Make a column chart to compare the six brands (no numbers or claims).' with exactly 'Use a column chart to compare all six supplied brand counts.' The parenthetical was an image-authoring instruction and must not appear in the teaching material. Keep the exact seven step titles, every other text, layout, dimensions, style, icons and colours unchanged. Keep the simple generic chart icon as a conceptual icon, not measured data. Do not add numerical values or claim work is completed.
